# LP and MIP modelling

In the facility-location model we use binary variables y_i in {0,1} to indicate whether a facility is open.

A binary variable y_i ∈ {0,1} takes one of exactly two values.

The relaxation gap is greater than zero for degenerate instances.

We solve the teaching instance with n = 10 machines.

The dual is bounded at optimality.

Each cost coefficient scales its own decision variable.
